summary: Mandatory license for manufacturers, packers, and importers of pre-packaged goods sold to retail consumers.

steps.title: Review mandatory label declarations
steps.description: Ensure product packaging specifies manufacturer name, net weight, MRP, date of packaging, and customer care details.

steps.title: Submit Rule 27 application
steps.description: Apply online on Legal Metrology portal submitting business registration and manufacturing unit location.

steps.title: Sample verification
steps.description: Legal Metrology inspector verifies declarations against standard metric units (g, kg, ml, l).

steps.title: Certificate grant
steps.description: Receive manufacturer/packer registration certificate with official registration number.
